execution_policy.time_semantics: Existing windows are reservations and diagnostic checkpoints. Earlier actual starts require predecessor outputs, active owner/lease, free capacity and an explicit allocation update; no automatic window compression.
execution_policy.unit_of_dispatch: Persistent writer lane containing its continuous assigned tasks; tasks remain separate acceptance units.
priority: producer outputs releasing the Atlas/memory critical tail

critical_output_groups.rule: Integrate the ready critical batch before composition/qualification; never wait for T25.
Do not pretend protected storage was ready in the T20 batch.
Start proofs whose complete inputs are ready; do not block them on unrelated late outputs.
Prioritize the real producer and all six consumers. Earlier delivery requires observed completed work, not a smaller date in the plan.

reviewer_early_start.scope: An early partial review states its actual SHA and scope; final complete coverage and affected-delta rechecks remain mandatory.

execution_policy.freeze_rule: latest feasible freeze = T118 minus observed resource-constrained critical tail for all remaining mandatory CI/live/review gates. Unknown latency preserves UNKNOWN/CONDITIONAL; T103 is not unconditional.
execution_policy.communication: Real local collaboration events inside a session; proven cross-session adapter when available. Git receipt index with bounded coordinator polling is an explicit fallback, not an invented push bus.
execution_policy.recovery: Consult actual session state and checkpoint before resume; no duplicate writer after a timeout. Takeover requires closed/revoked prior write authority, lease transfer, new epoch and head CAS.
execution_policy.unmeasured_operating_target: Critical output handling immediately when its owner and S0 are available; normal ready-queue age below two minutes when S0 is available. This is a target, not measured performance.

supervisor_workflow.other_N_policy: Compile and validate a complete new allocation against observed capacity before execution. Do not retain the 20-slot schedule with fewer actual sessions or assume extra model/runner capacity.
supervisor_workflow.missing_adapter_policy: Current collaboration tools expose a global four-slot limit, not five independent four-slot pools. Git is a ledger and cannot launch or wake sessions. Full automation requires a proven independent-session backend. An assisted five-conversation start is usable only after actual startup and capacity verification; Git receipts still do not auto-wake an idle chat.
supervisor_workflow.terminal_success: Full scope on final candidate; all mandatory evidence accepted; three independent reviewers; no mandatory open findings; final commit and receipts verified.
admission_conditions: backend actually creates or acknowledges five independent sessions
independent capacity pools verified, not inferred from five session IDs
twenty total slots verified including coordinators, without exceeding a global backend cap
model and CI concurrency measured separately
all sessions acknowledge pinned plan SHA and unique lane leases

dod: Observed roster, versioned lane missions, consumed outputs, complete receipts and final full-scope candidate.
invariants: One writer per file; no more than observed capacity; three non-author reviewers; all scope and mandatory gates retained; unknown duration is never zero.
quality_standards: Dispatch by critical-path impact with concise SHA-based events; no blind mutable retry or duplicate implementation.
completeness_criteria: All 74 tasks, 15 WPs, 17 contracts, 19 handoffs and required proofs remain assigned; correction owners survive builder replacement.
success_criteria: Measured reduction of repeated reads, queue waiting and duplicate work; two-hour completion claimed only from actual full acceptance time.

do_not_change: baseline windows merely to claim faster delivery
recommended_patch_policy: Only the first replacement is immediately safe as clarification. Additive policies require integration with the other proposals and validation. No numeric schedule compression is proposed.
